title: Trace base change and diagonal restriction of presented affine integration
statement: In the finite setting [def-pur-conventions], let Y be separated finite type over k, d,r≥0, and let ell^(r+1) annihilate A. Put X=affine d-space over Y, W=X×_Y X, p₁,p₂ the projections and s the diagonal. For every normalized Rees comparison of [def-pur-normal-bundle], there are isomorphisms I,J,Q whose hom maps are exactly the presented integration transposes of [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions] for X→Y, W→X and the normal cone→X. Under the canonical Tate restrictions, J=B∘Lp₂*I, where B is the specified counit-transposed dualizing base-change map. Writing alpha for [lem-pur-diagonal-base-change] and T for the pullback of J along s with its Tate/source comparisons, T followed by alpha equals I. There is no DNC arrow or DNC-normalization equation in this assertion.

proof.text: For any coordinate presentation e:U≅affineTraceTower B d, affineCoordinateCounit_baseChange makes the actual tower counit transpose invertible. Its final singleFunctorObjUnitIso.hom is identity by the upstream unit-coherence theorem. Unfold affineDiagonalPresentedTranspose: the Tate pullback, pullback compositor and coefficient descent are isomorphisms; the pullback of the tower transpose is invertible. Its final exceptional base-change map is invertible since both horizontal maps e.hom and id_B are isomorphisms. Apply this to p, p₁ and the normalized normal-cone coordinates to obtain I,J,Q by asIso.

proof.text: Expand T, alpha and diagonalComparedRestriction. The sourceComparison and its inverse cancel. Pull back the equation for J and cancel B with its inverse. Naturality of the canonical pullback section compositor at I moves I to the right. The remaining coefficient composite is identity by orderedTateSectionPullback. Apply the comparison functor to the resulting ordinary etale equality.
